030/**
031 * Holds resolved metadata for an interface annotated with {@link Remote @Remote}.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * Built once per interface class and cached for efficient proxy invocation.
035 * Use {@link #of(Class)} to obtain instances.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack.
039 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
040 * (and possibly earlier).
041 *
042 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
043 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
044 * </ul>
045 *
046 * @since 9.2.1
047 */
048public final class RrpcInterfaceMeta {
049
050   private static final Map<Class<?>,RrpcInterfaceMeta> CACHE = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();
051
052   private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger("org.apache.juneau.http.remote");
053
054   /** Interfaces already warned about {@link Remote#headerList()}, to keep the build-time warning one-time. */
055   private static final Set<Class<?>> HEADERLIST_WARNED = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
056
057   private final Class<?> iface;
058   private final String basePath;
059   // Interface-level base/host override: an annotation-declared substitute for the client root URL.
060   private final String baseUrl;
061   // Interface-level content negotiation: default accept + contentType media-type overrides.
062   private final String accept;
063   private final String contentType;
064   private final List<Map.Entry<String,String>> headers;
065   private final List<Map.Entry<String,String>> queryData;
066   private final List<Map.Entry<String,String>> formData;
067   // Interface-level custom part serializer: from @HttpPartMarshalling(serializer=...) on the interface.
068   private final HttpPartSerializer partSerializer;
069   // Interface-level cross-cutting call policy: defaults inherited by every method.
070   private final Class<?>[] interceptorClasses;
071   private final String timeout;
072   private final int retries;
073   private final boolean retryNonIdempotent;
074   private final boolean throwOnError;
075   private final boolean allowPrivateUrls;
076   private final Map<Method,RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta> methodMetas;
077   private final Map<String,RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta> methodMetasByPath;
078
079   private RrpcInterfaceMeta(Class<?> iface) {
080      this(iface, false);
081   }
082
083   /**
084    * Constructor.
085    *
086    * <p>
087    * Provides backwards compatibility with the classic {@code RrpcInterfaceMeta} signature; the {@code uri}
088    * argument is accepted for API parity and is currently ignored by this implementation.
089    *
090    * <p>
091    * Unlike {@link #of(Class)}, this constructor includes <i>all</i> public interface methods (matching the
092    * classic behavior), not just those annotated with the {@code @Remote*} annotations.
093    *
094    * @param iface The interface class. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
095    * @param uri Reserved for compatibility with the classic constructor. May be <jk>null</jk>.
096    */
097   @SuppressWarnings({
098      "java:S1172" // 'uri' is part of the public constructor signature retained for API parity with the classic RrpcInterfaceMeta; intentionally ignored
099   })
100   public RrpcInterfaceMeta(Class<?> iface, String uri) {
101      this(reqnn("iface", iface), true);
102   }
103
104   private RrpcInterfaceMeta(Class<?> iface, boolean includeUnannotated) {
105      if (!iface.isInterface())
106         throw iaex("Class %s is not an interface", iface.getName());
107      var remote = iface.getAnnotation(Remote.class);
108
109      this.iface = iface;
110      this.basePath = buildBasePath(remote);
111      this.baseUrl = buildBaseUrl(remote);
112      this.accept = buildAccept(remote);
113      this.contentType = buildContentType(remote);
114      this.headers = buildHeaders(remote);
115      this.queryData = buildQueryData(remote);
116      this.formData = buildFormData(remote);
117      this.partSerializer = buildPartSerializer(iface);
118      // Interface-level cross-cutting policy defaults.
119      this.interceptorClasses = buildInterceptorClasses(remote);
120      this.timeout = buildTimeout(remote);
121      this.retries = buildRetries(remote);
122      this.retryNonIdempotent = buildRetryNonIdempotent(remote);
123      this.throwOnError = buildThrowOnError(remote);
124      this.allowPrivateUrls = buildAllowPrivateUrls(remote);
125      warnHeaderListUnsupported(iface, remote);
126
127      var metas = new LinkedHashMap<Method,RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta>();
128      for (var m : iface.getMethods()) {
129         var opt = buildMethodMeta(m);
130         if (opt.isPresent()) {
131            metas.put(m, opt.get());
132         } else if (includeUnannotated) {
133            metas.put(m, new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta(m, "POST", buildSignaturePath(m), RemoteReturn.BODY));
134         }
135      }
136      this.methodMetas = u(metas);
137
138      var byPath = new LinkedHashMap<String,RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta>();
139      for (var v : metas.values())
140         byPath.put(v.getPath(), v);
141      this.methodMetasByPath = u(byPath);
142   }
143
144   private static String buildBasePath(Remote remote) {
145      if (remote == null)
146         return "";
147      return remote.path().isEmpty() ? remote.value() : remote.path();
148   }
149
150   private static String buildBaseUrl(Remote remote) {
151      return remote == null ? "" : VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(remote.baseUrl());
152   }
153
154   private static String buildAccept(Remote remote) {
155      return remote == null ? "" : VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(remote.accept());
156   }
157
158   private static String buildContentType(Remote remote) {
159      return remote == null ? "" : VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(remote.contentType());
160   }
161
162   private static List<Map.Entry<String,String>> buildQueryData(Remote remote) {
163      return remote == null ? List.of() : parseConstantParts(remote.queryData(), '=');
164   }
165
166   private static List<Map.Entry<String,String>> buildFormData(Remote remote) {
167      return remote == null ? List.of() : parseConstantParts(remote.formData(), '=');
168   }
169
170   private static HttpPartSerializer buildPartSerializer(Class<?> iface) {
171      var hpm = iface.getAnnotation(HttpPartMarshalling.class);
172      return hpm == null ? null : RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.resolvePartSerializer(hpm.serializer());
173   }
174
175   private static Class<?>[] buildInterceptorClasses(Remote remote) {
176      return remote == null ? new Class<?>[0] : remote.interceptors();
177   }
178
179   private static String buildTimeout(Remote remote) {
180      return remote == null ? "" : remote.timeout();
181   }
182
183   private static int buildRetries(Remote remote) {
184      return remote == null ? 0 : remote.retries();
185   }
186
187   private static boolean buildRetryNonIdempotent(Remote remote) {
188      return remote != null && remote.retryNonIdempotent();
189   }
190
191   private static boolean buildThrowOnError(Remote remote) {
192      return remote != null && remote.throwOnError();
193   }
194
195   private static boolean buildAllowPrivateUrls(Remote remote) {
196      return remote != null && remote.allowPrivateUrls();
197   }

199   /**
200    * Emits a one-time build-time warning when {@link Remote#headerList()} is set on an interface used with the
201    * next-generation engine.
202    *
203    * <p>
204    * {@code headerList()} is a genuinely engine-specific member: its value type is a classic
205    * {@code org.apache.juneau.http.classic.header.HeaderList} subclass that is tied to the Apache-HttpClient
206    * transport, so the transport-agnostic next-generation engine cannot honor it.  Rather than silently ignore it,
207    * we warn (at most once per interface) and point the caller at the transport-agnostic {@link Remote#headers()}
208    * member instead.
209    *
210    * @param iface The proxy interface.
211    * @param remote The resolved {@link Remote} annotation (may be <jk>null</jk>).
212    */
213   private static void warnHeaderListUnsupported(Class<?> iface, Remote remote) {
214      if (remote == null || remote.headerList() == Void.class)
215         return;
216      if (HEADERLIST_WARNED.add(iface))
217         LOG.warning(() -> "@Remote member 'headerList' set on " + iface.getName()
218            + " is not honored by the next-generation REST-proxy engine: its value type is a classic"
219            + " Apache-HttpClient HeaderList that is transport-specific."
220            + "  Use the transport-agnostic headers() member instead.");
221   }
222
223   /**
224    * Resolves the interface-level constant headers declared via {@link Remote#headers()} and the client-version
225    * header derived from {@link Remote#version()}/{@link Remote#versionHeader()}.
226    *
227    * <p>
228    * Each {@code headers()} entry is a {@code "Name: value"} string (the colon-separated form), resolved through
229    * {@link VarResolver#DEFAULT} so values such as {@code "$S{sysprop}"} expand.  A non-empty {@code version()}
230    * appends a {@code Client-Version} header (or the name given by {@code versionHeader()}).
231    *
232    * <p>
233    * <b>Note:</b> {@link Remote#headerList()} is intentionally <i>not</i> honored by the next-gen engine — its value
234    * type is a classic {@code org.apache.juneau.http.classic.header.HeaderList} subclass that is specific to the
235    * Apache-HttpClient transport.  Use {@code headers()} for transport-agnostic constant headers.
236    */
237   private static List<Map.Entry<String,String>> buildHeaders(Remote remote) {
238      if (remote == null)
239         return List.of();
240      var l = new ArrayList<>(parseConstantParts(remote.headers(), ':'));
241      var version = VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(remote.version());
242      if (! version.isEmpty()) {
243         var vh = remote.versionHeader().isEmpty() ? "Client-Version" : VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(remote.versionHeader());
244         l.add(Map.entry(vh, version));
245      }
246      return u(l);
247   }
248
249   /**
250    * Parses an array of constant {@code "name<delim>value"} strings into resolved name/value entries.
251    *
252    * <p>
253    * Each entry is resolved through {@link VarResolver#DEFAULT} (so values such as {@code "$S{sysprop}"} expand), then
254    * split on the first occurrence of {@code delim} ({@code ':'} for the {@code "Name: value"} header form, {@code '='}
255    * for the {@code "name=value"} query/form-data form).  Entries with no delimiter are skipped.  Both the name and the
256    * value are trimmed.
257    *
258    * @param entries The raw annotation strings (may be empty).
259    * @param delim The name/value delimiter character.
260    * @return An unmodifiable list of resolved name/value entries. Never <jk>null</jk>, but may be empty.
261    */
262   static List<Map.Entry<String,String>> parseConstantParts(String[] entries, char delim) {
263      if (entries.length == 0)
264         return List.of();
265      var l = new ArrayList<Map.Entry<String,String>>();
266      for (var e : entries) {
267         var s = VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(e);
268         var i = s.indexOf(delim);
269         if (i != -1)
270            l.add(Map.entry(s.substring(0, i).trim(), s.substring(i + 1).trim()));
271      }
272      return u(l);
273   }
274
275   private static String buildSignaturePath(Method m) {
276      var sb = new StringBuilder(128);
277      sb.append(m.getName()).append('/');
278      Class<?>[] pt = m.getParameterTypes();
279      if (pt.length == 0)
280         return sb.toString();
281      sb.append('(');
282      for (var i = 0; i < pt.length; i++) {
283         if (i > 0)
284            sb.append(',');
285         appendTypeName(sb, pt[i]);
286      }
287      sb.append(')');
288      return sb.toString();
289   }
290
291   private static void appendTypeName(StringBuilder sb, Class<?> c) {
292      if (c.isArray()) {
293         appendTypeName(sb, c.getComponentType());
294         sb.append("[]");
295      } else {
296         sb.append(c.getName());
297      }
298   }

300   /**
301    * Returns the {@link RrpcInterfaceMeta} for the given interface, creating and caching it if necessary.
302    *
303    * @param iface The interface class. Must be annotated with {@link Remote}. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
304    * @return The metadata. Never <jk>null</jk>.
305    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the class is not an interface or not annotated with {@link Remote}.
306    */
307   public static RrpcInterfaceMeta of(Class<?> iface) {
308      reqnn("iface", iface);
309      if (!iface.isInterface())
310         throw iaex("Class %s is not an interface", iface.getName());
311      if (iface.getAnnotation(Remote.class) == null)
312         throw iaex("Class %s is not annotated with @Remote", iface.getName());
313      return CACHE.computeIfAbsent(iface, RrpcInterfaceMeta::new);
314   }

538   @SuppressWarnings({
539      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity inherent to per-verb interface-metadata parsing; refactoring would reduce readability without benefit.
540   })
541   private static Optional<RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta> buildMethodMeta(Method m) {
542      if (m.isAnnotationPresent(RemoteGet.class)) {
543         var a = m.getAnnotation(RemoteGet.class);
544         return o(simpleMeta(m, "GET", a.path(), a.value(), a.returns(), a.headers(), a.queryData(), a.formData(), a.baseUrl(),
545            new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.Policy(a.interceptors(), a.timeout(), a.retries(), a.retryNonIdempotent(), a.throwOnError()),
546            neg(a.accept(), a.contentType())));
547      }
548      if (m.isAnnotationPresent(RemotePost.class)) {
549         var a = m.getAnnotation(RemotePost.class);
550         return o(simpleMeta(m, "POST", a.path(), a.value(), a.returns(), a.headers(), a.queryData(), a.formData(), a.baseUrl(),
551            new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.Policy(a.interceptors(), a.timeout(), a.retries(), a.retryNonIdempotent(), a.throwOnError()),
552            neg(a.accept(), a.contentType())));
553      }
554      if (m.isAnnotationPresent(RemotePut.class)) {
555         var a = m.getAnnotation(RemotePut.class);
556         return o(simpleMeta(m, "PUT", a.path(), a.value(), a.returns(), a.headers(), a.queryData(), a.formData(), a.baseUrl(),
557            new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.Policy(a.interceptors(), a.timeout(), a.retries(), a.retryNonIdempotent(), a.throwOnError()),
558            neg(a.accept(), a.contentType())));
559      }
560      if (m.isAnnotationPresent(RemotePatch.class)) {
561         var a = m.getAnnotation(RemotePatch.class);
562         return o(simpleMeta(m, "PATCH", a.path(), a.value(), a.returns(), a.headers(), a.queryData(), a.formData(), a.baseUrl(),
563            new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.Policy(a.interceptors(), a.timeout(), a.retries(), a.retryNonIdempotent(), a.throwOnError()),
564            neg(a.accept(), a.contentType())));
565      }
566      if (m.isAnnotationPresent(RemoteDelete.class)) {
567         var a = m.getAnnotation(RemoteDelete.class);
568         return o(simpleMeta(m, "DELETE", a.path(), a.value(), a.returns(), a.headers(), a.queryData(), a.formData(), a.baseUrl(),
569            new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.Policy(a.interceptors(), a.timeout(), a.retries(), a.retryNonIdempotent(), a.throwOnError()),
570            neg(a.accept(), a.contentType())));
571      }
572      if (m.isAnnotationPresent(RemoteOp.class))
573         return o(buildRemoteOpMeta(m, m.getAnnotation(RemoteOp.class)));
574
575      return oe();
576   }

578   /**
579    * Builds a resolved {@link RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.ContentNegotiation} carrier from the raw
580    * {@code accept}/{@code contentType} annotation members, expanding {@link VarResolver#DEFAULT} variables.
581    */
582   private static RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.ContentNegotiation neg(String accept, String contentType) {
583      return new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.ContentNegotiation(VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(accept), VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(contentType));
584   }

587      "java:S107" // The 11 parameters mirror the verb-annotation surface (verb/path/value/return + the 3 constant-part arrays + the baseUrl override + the cross-cutting policy carrier + the content-negotiation carrier) threaded into the method-meta; holder types would add indirection without improving this internal builder.
588   })
589   private static RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta simpleMeta(Method m, String httpMethod, String pathAttr, String valueAttr, RemoteReturn returnType, String[] headers, String[] queryData, String[] formData, String baseUrl, RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.Policy policy, RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.ContentNegotiation neg) {
590      var path = pathAttr.isEmpty() ? valueAttr : pathAttr;
591      return new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta(m, httpMethod, path, returnType,
592         parseConstantParts(headers, ':'),
593         parseConstantParts(queryData, '='),
594         parseConstantParts(formData, '='),
595         VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(baseUrl),
596         policy,
597         neg);
598   }
599
600   private static RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta buildRemoteOpMeta(Method m, RemoteOp a) {
601      var method = a.method().trim();
602      var path = a.path().trim();
603      var returnType = a.returns();
604      var v = a.value().trim();
605      if (!v.isEmpty()) {
606         var i = v.indexOf(' ');
607         if (i == -1) {
608            method = ucr(v);
609         } else {
610            method = ucr(v.substring(0, i).trim());
611            path = v.substring(i).trim();
612         }
613      }
614      if (path.isEmpty())
615         path = HttpUtils.detectHttpPath(m, isEmpty(method) ? null : method);
616      if (method.isEmpty())
617         method = HttpUtils.detectHttpMethod(m, true, "GET");
618      if (!isOneOf(method, "DELETE", "GET", "POST", "PUT", "OPTIONS", "HEAD", "CONNECT", "TRACE", "PATCH"))
619         throw iaex("Invalid @RemoteOp method '%s' on %s.%s", method, m.getDeclaringClass().getName(), m.getName());
620      return new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta(m, method, trimSlashes(path), returnType,
621         parseConstantParts(a.headers(), ':'),
622         parseConstantParts(a.queryData(), '='),
623         parseConstantParts(a.formData(), '='),
624         VarResolver.DEFAULT.resolve(a.baseUrl()),
625         new RrpcInterfaceMethodMeta.Policy(a.interceptors(), a.timeout(), a.retries(), a.retryNonIdempotent(), a.throwOnError()),
626         neg(a.accept(), a.contentType()));
627   }

630   public String toString() {
631      return "@Remote " + iface.getSimpleName() + " (basePath=" + basePath + ", methods=" + methodMetas.size() + ")";
632   }
